address: via Circondariale San Francesco 2, Fiorano Modenese, 41042, Italy
bio: The top floor of the renovated Executive Spa Hotel now houses chef Mattia Trabetti’s fine-dining restaurant, where the rooftop dining room boasts relaxing views of the surrounding hills and the Santuario della Beata Vergine del Castello through its floor-to-ceiling windows. The young, innovative cuisine is showcased on a “green” tasting menu (Emilia Vegetale) with a seasonal and regional focus, as well as on a menu dedicated to local traditions (Modena Safari). Original options that will appeal to curious palates include trout with alchermes, cat fish and hops; green tagliatelle with chicory, black garlic and roe (with grated egg adding an interesting twist); and Montese-style duck.
